f.t: Or *what He has entrusted to me*
Or *the good deposit entrusted to you*
Literally *in Asia*; Asia was a Roman province in what is now western Turkey.

w.t: we will also live with Him;
we will also reign with Him;
they will come to their senses

f.t: See Jasher 79:27. *The Book of Jashar* or *the Book of the Upright One* is often cited as *Jasher*.

w.t: being poured out like a drink offering,
